cards.title: Chain of Command
cards.instruction: Treat every question, favor, and decision as something that must travel through the proper hierarchy.

cards.title: Start the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to explain, announce, or begin the emotionally difficult part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As eldest, you should tell Mum we're selling the house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're the one who wants to sell it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The proposal originated below you. The announcement requires seniority.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can't hide behind my birthday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm respecting the family hierarchy. You say 'selling'; I'll explain the plumbing afterwards.

before.seedUse: The choir cancellation and house sale are Drive seeds; delegating the announcement up the authority chain embodies the Stance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're the eldest. You tell Mum I think it's time to sell her house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're twins. You're forty seconds younger. Tell her yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll submit the proposal to you, and you can raise it with Mum.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I reject the proposal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She'll want to know what you've rejected. Could you start with that?

cards.title: Practical Realist
cards.instruction: Accept any unusual premise without debate. Focus immediately on schedules, costs, safety, and what must happen next.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

cards.title: Cleared to Know
cards.instruction: Treat access to private information as proof that you belong, and exclusion from any detail as a challenge to your legitimacy.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

cards.title: Everything Is Policy
cards.instruction: Treat every personal choice as evidence of a larger system. Connect exceptions, habits, and coincidences until they become institutional doctrine.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay

cards.title: Top of the Ladder

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
